conventions.state_packing: state = l0 | (l1 << NCELLS); slot 2 always empty (nodes are post-shift states)
conventions.window_coords: edge k fill pieces relative to layer k: (x,y,dz), dz in {0,1,2}; absolute cell = (x,y,k+dz)
conventions.edge_legality_definition: pieces of edge k must each be congruent to piece.geometry under proper rotation, be pairwise disjoint, avoid all cells occupied by state s_k, complete slot 0 of s_k, and shift(s_k + pieces) == s_{k+1}
conventions.semantics_note: machine-pinned identifier; the prose fields below are human-readable restatements of the same pinned semantics and are not parsed by checkers

provenance.source_tiling: hand-built synthetic; trivial self-loop walk of the I pentacube in a 1x5 cross-section (one upright-free flat piece per layer); smoke test for degenerate cases only, not research evidence

claims.statement: The I-pentacube Macro graph on cross-section 1x5 has the self-loop 0 -> 0 (cycle length 1): each layer is completed by a single piece lying wholly in slot 0.
